title: An Ising-based Decision Method for Intra Prediction Mode in Video Coding
problem: Conventional computers struggle to solve the combinatorial optimization problem of selecting appropriate intra prediction modes in video coding due to exponential computational complexity. The mode selection requires evaluating numerous parameter combinations, making it intractable for traditional sequential processing.
motivation: High-efficiency video compression is critical for video AI and transmission systems deployed in logistics, transportation, and large-scale factory automation.
method: The intra prediction mode selection problem is formulated as a QUBO (Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization) model. This QUBO formulation is executed on an Ising machine (Fixstars Amplify Annealing Engine), specialized hardware that uses quantum annealing principles to explore the combinatorial solution space in parallel, avoiding the exponential time complexity of conventional search.
key_novelty: Formulating intra prediction mode selection in video coding as a QUBO model solvable by Ising machines to achieve massive speedups over conventional computers.
contributions: QUBO formulation of intra prediction mode selection enabling Ising machine execution
70x speedup in finding optimal prediction modes compared to conventional computers
Enables solving video encoding optimization problems previously intractable on conventional hardware
Demonstrates practical application of Ising machines to video codec optimization
primary_theme: Ising machines for video codec optimization
